pages.title: A Tale of Temporal Milestones — Schrödinger’s Cat
pages.text: Where did we leave off? That GOD is the WORLD, and it is ETERNAL. In what way, then, can this Perpetual Motion Machine exist, considering that it is almost the only possible one, if it is possible at all. --- The question arises: is there in the world any known, sufficiently studied ETERNAL SYSTEM? Imagine, such a system exists! It is the virtual “particle/antiparticle” pair, now appearing, now disappearing in the vacuum, thanks to fluctuations of the eternal physical field itself, by means of annihilation. Everyone knows that matter and energy are capable of transforming into one another. There is no formula in the world more famous than Einstein’s equation, which reflects these transformations. It is hard to find a person who has never heard that “e equals m c squared.” The relation describes the mutual reincarnations of mass and energy, asserting that energy is equivalent to mass multiplied by the square of the speed of light. And if the energy, God forbid, is negative, then the mass will be negative as well, since the speed of light is present squared. The process of annihilation is the only way for matter to pass completely into radiation. More precisely, for matter and antimatter to pass into radiation and back. Because annihilation requires the presence of antipodes - quantities of one modality, but with opposite signs. The term “annihilation” (nihil - nothing) is used to designate the phenomenon in which a particle and its corresponding antiparticle “disappear,” turning into photons or still lighter quanta of an electromagnetic or other field. Pair creation is the reverse process, in which, as a result of the interaction of physical fields, a particle and an antiparticle arise simultaneously. It is appropriate here to recall that field quanta (energy-bearing particles) can serve as antipodes to themselves, and are therefore suitable for annihilation. Because of the “repetition of the large in the small,” mutually annihilating antipodes may be either quite “elementary” or infinitely complex: from quarks to universes. The Big Bang (also the Big Crunch) is also the most ordinary annihilation of matter with antimatter. Only the scale of the phenomenon differs. Naturally, the interval of time between annihilations is the greater, the higher the complexity of the structures participating in this infinite cyclic process. In the case of whole worlds (the universe and the anti-universe), these are long billions of years. --- The total sum of all parameters in antipodes is always pairwise equal to zero, since the physical categories of each of the mirror copies have opposite signs. Geneva physicists consider studies of antimatter a penetration into another mathematical universe, where everything positive becomes negative, and left becomes right. But one ought to say - INTO ANOTHER PHYSICAL REALITY. Into a world where, according to the rule of CPT symmetry, space, its curvature, time, and other indicators acquire the minus sign characteristic of the “looking-glass world.” Mass in the symmetrical reality is represented by the square of tachyonic, imaginary mass. (Taking into account the baryonic mass familiar to us of the same modulus - “three quarks for Mister Mark” have begun to glimmer). But an imaginary number, raised to the square, gives a negative number; that is, at the moment of the “Big Bang,” the mutually annihilating quantities easily acquire strictly opposite signs, otherwise they would be summed rather than zeroed out. Accordingly, energy is negative in the anti-world as well, including entropy, since time flowing backward means the inevitable reversibility of entropic processes and cause-and-effect relationships. Negative entropy is information, according to the definition of Brillouin, not often mentioned in “broad circles of narrow specialists.” How can such a dual system be represented mathematically? It is not difficult, for the aggregate, in particular, of masses for complete copies-antipodes is equal to zero. --- It has long been known (algebra is smarter than the natural scientist) that zero is a complex number, containing real and imaginary parts. The imaginary unit is denoted by the symbol “i,” and in the first power it is the square root of minus one, while when raised to the second power - “I^2” (“i” squared), it is equated to minus one. Therefore THE FORMULA OF EVERYTHING: 0 = Nothing = x-x = x +(- x) = x + (-1) (x) = x + (i^2)(x) = Something In the case of the annihilative interaction of worlds, instead of “x” one may insert the sum of all baryonic mass of the universe, for example. One may use the left or right side of Einstein’s equation... however, the modulus of the quantity as such is not important at all, as long as one does not forget the corresponding exact antipode. But “SOMETHING,” with regard to universal scales, is a synonym for the word “EVERYTHING.” Even if there are many pairs of such worlds (out of respect for old Occam, they can be neglected), the principle does not change: self-sufficient and eternal is the dual, dialectically contradictory essence. The chief prerequisite, the indispensable condition of eternity, is the presence of antipodes. The physical world is eternal according to the Law of Conservation precisely because, in addition to the material Universe, it includes an imaginary (“virtual”) component - the ANTI-UNIVERSE consisting of antimatter. Why is the thought of an anti-universe, which occurred to scientists more than once, no longer popular? It was rejected on the grounds that even the seemingly most perfect optical instruments were for a long time unable to register its objects. The patience of learned men snapped. But how could it happen that, even after dark matter was discovered, they did not return to the hypothesis of the anti-universe? Quantum mechanics speaks of negative mass, superluminal velocities, and the like in passing, furtively, and with a guilty look. Compromised and ridiculed, the idea of a CPT-symmetric anti-world “is in the air” and... awaits its hour. --- “Dark,” visually unregistered matter is precisely accumulations of supposedly “disappeared” antimatter. The antipodes are separated solely by the barrier of velocities, and the speed of objects abiding in negative time is superluminal. “When you fly much faster than light, you will reach the goal at seven in the morning - yesterday.” In general and on the whole, EVERYTHING THAT EXISTS is INFORMATION, with its inherent binary code. Yes, yes, one and zero. But taking into account the complexity of zero, which makes it possible to employ imaginary and negative numbers, extremely necessary in order to describe the metamorphoses of that one fundamental essence whose existence Lee Smolin suspects. A system claiming completeness is necessarily contradictory, and it is naive to suppose that it can be described within the bounds of, say, exclusively positive numbers of the natural sequence. Therefore, when applying renormalization, think of a yellow monkey! The cybernetic system “ALL THAT EXISTS” is possible, first, in the form of an information field, dual, naturally (a measure of chaos is nothing other than a measure of order with the opposite sign). Second, it may represent any other energy field whose quanta act as their own antipodes. And finally, the energy of annihilation may be realized in gradually developing and then slowly involuting structural elements of antipodal worlds. The process lasts until the next annihilation, and the whole cycle repeats “ad infinitum.” Information, therefore, is a kind of “genetic matrix of the world.” Well, how can one not recall the “double helix of DNA” of inconsolable Avery? --- The most meticulous have long been racking their brains over where the antiparticles went. The primary universe teemed with pairs of antipodes. The process of annihilation clearly did not take place: the material world - here it is! Moreover, if we try hard, we can even extract from nonbeing, well, let us say, antihydrogen. “Know-how”! Therefore the correct answer is: we do not see the gopher, but it is there! Antimatter is hiding from us somewhere. Let us stir our brains. We see only the light that has reached the “rods and cones.” To get from a light source to the receptors of the retina, photons require some time. Every flash (emission of photons) is registered later than it occurred. Therefore, the motion of photons, and of everything in general in the direction from “event” to “observer,” takes place from the past into the future (the normal flow of time). But movement away from the observer is directed backward - into the past, that is. Movement from the future into the past can occur either with a decrease in the modulus of positive numbers or with an increase in the modulus of negative numbers, depending on the value of the initial moment of time. With a negative increment of the positive modulus, subluminal speed makes it possible to register only compression, the slowing of positive time. At the speed of light, the negative increment “levels out” the entire course of positive time. Time is zeroed out, stops. Energy-bearing particles “spin their wheels” in time and, demonstrating wave properties, multiply. Do you guess what will happen to superluminal objects? Exactly! Time for superluminal objects is always with a minus sign, and therefore they are cosmic invisibles. --- To reject negative time with its transcendent velocities is equivalent to rejecting the theory of relativity. Einstein himself bears some guilt for the emergence of such an incident, having once declared: “since all our experience gives no evidence of a violation of cause-and-effect relations, the impossibility of superluminal velocities may be considered proven, despite the fact that the existence of a signal-transmission mechanism in which the effect precedes the cause contains no logical contradictions.” And only the obstinate Gell-Mann, author of the “law of conservation of strangeness,” gloomily grumbled in reply: “Everything that is not forbidden is mandatory!” Honor and praise to the stubborn man!

pages.title: TWINS WITHOUT A PARADOX — Schrödinger’s Cat
pages.text: It is indeed a dreadful crime Not to admit the backward time. Once Einstein declared: "We are compelled to consider possible a mechanism of signal transmission in which the resulting effect precedes its cause. This result contains no logical contradictions!" He caught the disapproving murmurs of his colleagues and hastened to add: "However, since all our experience provides no evidence of violations of cause-and-effect relationships, the impossibility of superluminal velocities may be regarded as proven." Everyone breathed a sigh of relief, and only the obstinate M. Gell-Mann stubbornly muttered: "Everything that is not forbidden is compulsory!" Einstein nodded understandingly and spread his hands apologetically. At that unfortunate moment, unnoticed by anyone, the "Twin Paradox" made its appearance. "There are no real paradoxes in physics," R. Feynman maintains. "All paradoxes are merely confusion in our own understanding." The rejection of superluminal velocities (and therefore of negative time), contrary to the logic of the theory of relativity, led to the notion that a twin who makes a journey through space, completes a loop and returns to Earth will be younger than his stay-at-home brother. A paradox considered unresolved to this day. Yet the solution is remarkably simple. The human eye registers photons only when they reach the retina. Any flash of light occurs before it is seen, since photons require a certain amount of time to reach the observer. Thus, the movement of photons and indeed of all cosmic objects approaching the observer takes place "from earlier to later," from the past into the future — in ordinary positive time, with its absolute values increasing. Conversely, when moving away from the observer, motion proceeds backward, from the future into an ever more distant past as the distance increases. In other words, by changing direction in space, the traveler also changes the direction of movement through time. Therefore, during a round trip, the difference between the clocks of the traveling twin and his stay-at-home brother, arising and increasing on the outward journey, decreases on the return journey and disappears completely when the brothers meet. Embracing each other, they will once again be the same age, as twins should be. The logical error that gave rise to the paradox, as we can see, was that the direction of motion was ignored, while only the magnitude of velocity was taken into account. Unfortunately, negative time flowing backward (from the future into the past) is still far from universally accepted by researchers. But once it is taken into account — "there was a paradox, and now it's gone." It should be emphasized that at extreme (relativistic) velocities, the direction of motion is actually irrelevant: for lightlike objects, cause and effect are simultaneous, since, acquiring the properties of a wave, they set off and reach their destination synchronously, as though "multiplying" themselves, being in several places at once. Superluminal objects exist permanently in negative time, since they always outrun the light wave with which they originally "stood at the same starting line." They cannot, in principle, be observed directly and reveal themselves only through indirect signs. In negative time, entropic processes are reversible, and consequently the effect precedes the cause. And please don't say that this refutes the theory of relativity. More precisely, it represents a further development of that theory. Russian original: Samlib.

pages.title: The Vector of Time in the Machinery of the Universe — Schrödinger’s Cat
pages.text: (a careless lecture for lazy majors) If you are armed only with logic, facts, and common sense, your chances of being understood are practically nil. So, to save my time and yours, I will list the most important points in thesis form. Every emission of photons occurs before it is seen, because photons need a certain amount of time to reach the light-perceiving receptor cells of the observer’s eye. That means the motion of photons from an event to the observer takes place in the ordinary positive direction of time - from earlier to later, from the past into the future. Naturally, those photons that are not approaching but, on the contrary, moving away from the observer are not registered by vision at all. Unless, along the way, they encounter some object that reflects them and redirects them again toward the light-sensitive cells of the eye. The later, the farther from the observer such an encounter occurs, the more time the photons need to return to the recipient. That is, as they move away, photons find themselves in an ever deeper past relative to the observer, and this means that movement away from the recipient backward is movement BACKWARD in time. Whether it manifests only as a compression of positive time, or time is completely zeroed out, or even acquires negative values altogether, depends on the speed of the object moving in the light streams - the potential reflector of these photons. If its speed is subluminal, the photons will catch up with the object fairly soon. It will become a source of reflected light and, as such, sooner or later will be registered by the observer. In this case the registered time, having slowed somewhat, will remain positive. When the speed of motion is equal to the speed of light, the negative increment cancels out the entire positive flow of time. Time is “zeroed out,” stops, demonstrating the object’s manifestation of wave properties - the ability to be in several (many) places synchronously. All “massless,” energy-bearing particles possess precisely this speed. Among them there are both visible particles and “invisibles.” Therefore massless particles can serve as antiparticles to themselves. The fact that under certain conditions annihilation between them is possible - why is that not an explanation of the nature of electricity? And finally, for an object with a speed exceeding the speed of light, time is completely perverted - being directed from the future into the past, it acquires NEGATIVE values. All cosmic objects located in negative time are not visually registered. Antimatter constantly abides in negative time - in accordance with the rule of CPT symmetry. The principle is lawful both for quantum mechanics and for cosmic objects; antiparticles have spin different from particles and are sometimes available for observation, because the observer of quantum particles is capable of being outside the system. In any case, one must first of all realize that by changing direction in space, the traveler also changes the direction of motion in time. Unfortunately, time flowing backward, from the future into the past, is still far from being recognized by all researchers. And recognizing it would allow all unresolved problems of cosmology to be solved. For example, in the notorious twin paradox, the “there-and-back” journey is, as it were, movement in a loop of time - the difference between the readings of the traveler’s clock and the homebody’s clock, arising and increasing on the way “there,” decreases on the way back and disappears completely at the moment the brothers meet. The logical error that led to the paradox consisted in ignoring the vector of motion and taking into account only the magnitude of velocity. It is difficult to imagine a problem that would not be solved by recognizing the presence of invisible antimatter existing in the world of negative time and superluminal velocities (most likely, antimatter is the so-called “dark matter” of the universe). In particular, the source of the Big Bang’s energy becomes clear. It is quite simply the energy of yet another annihilation of all the matter of the Universe with all its antimatter in an endless chain of mutual transformations of antipodal worlds obeying the Law of Conservation. That is, Friedmann’s first model works, but not as the end of everything, only as the beginning of a new cycle. The system is self-sufficient and eternal, like the “particle-antiparticle” pair in a vacuum. Gravity, incidentally, is the natural attraction between antipodes. Are you familiar with the theory of “Loop Quantum Gravity”? Okay. That is all for now. We will continue the conversation next Thursday. When pigs fly.

pages.title: The Law of Antipodes (Nobel Lecture) — Schrödinger’s Cat
pages.text: Esteemed members of the Nobel Committee! Ladies and gentlemen! In mathematical logic, there exists Gödel’s incompleteness theorem, which states that any sufficiently complex formal system must necessarily be inconsistent in order to be complete. If we perceive the world adequately (otherwise we simply would not survive in it), we must conclude that contradiction is inherent not only in descriptive (formal), but also in described (real) systems that claim completeness. Thus, in addition to the material Universe known to all, there undoubtedly exists its antipode — an invisible, immaterial world composed of antimatter, representing an exact mirror image of our Universe. Time in this Anti-Universe flows backward, objects consist of antiparticles, energy is negative, and a portion of it — equal in magnitude but opposite in sign to universal entropy, i.e. negentropy — represents cosmic information fields, a kind of “Universal Mind.” The Anti-Universe, as a system with the above characteristics, obeys known physical laws, in particular the law of conservation, which guarantees the eternal existence of information as a component of the system’s negative energy. This allows us to assume... the eternity of our consciousness, which is nothing but information accumulated by an individual — about the surrounding world and about oneself. Since the reverse flow of time corresponds to decreasing entropy, it is logical to conclude that in the Anti-Universe all processes develop from chaos to order, “from worse to better.” As a result, highly organized systems have no need to struggle with the environment for survival, and thus the role of natural selection in their evolution disappears. The structure of such a world should be perceived by individuality as a kind of perfect “paradise,” in which the very prerequisites for evil are absent. The recognition of the existence of a non-material antipode alongside the Universe makes a supernatural Creator unnecessary, since such a dual world is self-sufficient, containing its own built-in mechanisms of infinite, cyclical emergence and development — from one annihilation to another (from “Big Bang” to “Big Crunch”) in a continuously repeating cycle. One may say that this dual world itself can be regarded as God — an eternal, indestructible essence, including information fields — the “Universal Mind” — as part of a single, all-encompassing organism. All existing types of fields, all material and immaterial formations, all objects and phenomena without exception are merely components and life processes of this contradictory, ever-changing, dynamic, and eternal organism. Objects of the Anti-Universe cannot be detected by an observer due to the limitations of our senses, which are evolutionarily adapted to perceive only the material world — the very world from which we, as a biological species, originate. In particular, a human can see celestial bodies only if they emit or reflect light. However, when an object moves faster than light — which is natural for motion in reverse (negative) time — a light wave cannot reflect from such an object, since it cannot catch up with it. Therefore, formations of the Anti-Universe remain invisible to us. Nevertheless, recognizing that no material particle can arise without a corresponding antiparticle, and that their disappearance is possible only in pairs through mutual annihilation, we must confidently conclude that antiparticles, like their material counterparts, have not vanished, but inevitably must have formed their own antimaterial world — a mirror antipode of the material Universe. The recognition of the duality of the existing world allows us to resolve many contradictions accumulated in modern physics and cosmology. The same recognition makes it possible to finally abandon the primitive, anthropomorphic “god” proposed by ancient religious texts and to give the only possible definition of the divine essence that does not contradict science and logic: God is everything that exists. Any attempt to place God — the creator of all that exists — outside His creation is meaningless, because that which lies outside everything that exists simply... does not exist. On the other hand, God cannot be a part of “everything that exists,” since the creator of a system cannot be simpler than the system itself, and any part of a system is, by definition, simpler than the whole. In other words, God is not a supernatural creator of Nature — God is Nature itself. God and Nature are synonyms. One must only take into account that Nature is exactly twice as complex as previously thought — due to the Anti-Universe. However, as a negative mass, it is possible that the square of an imaginary mass exists, providing the necessary “minus one” at the moment of annihilation. There is nothing supernatural in this system. The laws of God are the same as the laws of Nature, which a human, as a biological being, is simply incapable of violating, being merely a tiny particle of an all-encompassing organism, existing sequentially in its material and antimaterial parts and obeying their physical conditions. These, briefly, are the conclusions that follow from the Law of Antipodes — the First Law of the Universe. Thank you for your attention!

pages.title: How to read and listen — Schrödinger’s Cat
pages.text: Reading on the site, downloadable books and tools in your browser. 1. Read on the site Start with the complete works catalog for books, prose, poetry, articles and available translations. The novel Pereborsh is available in Russian. Its landing page has a table of contents linking to the introduction and chapters. Within each chapter, the Russian links «Назад» (Back), «Оглавление» (Contents) and «Далее» (Next) take you through the book. In a chapter, expand «Настройки чтения» (Reading settings) to enlarge the text or narrow the text column. The width option applies only on wide screens. «Сбросить настройки» (Reset settings) restores the original view. These controls are available when JavaScript is enabled. 2. Download a book PDF keeps the book’s page layout. EPUB reflows the text to fit your screen and chosen font size. The Schrödinger’s Cat on the Theory of Everything in a Patchwork Style landing page offers a PDF. The Pereborsh landing page offers both PDF and EPUB. Both books are in Russian; only Pereborsh has an EPUB edition. Save the file to your device and open it in a suitable PDF or EPUB reader to read offline. Visiting a book’s landing page does not save the download. 3. Listen to the text Your browser may be able to read the current page aloud. This does not translate it, and the site has no built-in audiobook. Voices, language support and commands depend on your browser, its version and your device. Some voices need an internet connection. Russian text needs a suitable Russian voice. Open an article or an individual chapter. Move to the next chapter yourself, then start playback again. Windows · Microsoft Edge, including PDFs Open an article or chapter, then choose menu (…) → More tools → Read aloud. Some versions show Read aloud directly in the menu. You can also press Ctrl+Shift+U. For a PDF, open the actual PDF file in Edge, using the link on the book’s landing page or a saved file. Choose Read aloud on the PDF toolbar rather than on the book’s description page. For a passage, select the text, right-click and choose Read aloud selection if that command is available. If playback stops after the first few words, try selecting the passage before restarting. A reader has tested this workaround. It is optional, and does not establish a cause or a universal defect. Further help: Microsoft Edge accessibility. Desktop · Google Chrome Right-click the page → Open in reading mode → Play. Use this option where it is available for your page and browser version. Further help: Chrome reading mode. Android · Google Chrome Choose menu (…) → Listen to this page. In the player, select Standard playback to hear all the words on the page. AI playback creates a conversation based on the page; an audio summary is not a word-for-word reading of the author’s text. Google’s instructions require the Make searches and browsing better setting to be enabled. Availability varies with the page, language and Chrome version. If the menu item is missing, this method is currently unavailable. Further help: Listen to this page in Chrome. Mobile · Microsoft Edge Look for Read aloud in the browser menu. Its exact location varies by version and device. If it is available, choose a suitable voice and reading speed. iPhone · Safari Open the page menu beside the address bar → Listen to Page, when available. This works with supported pages and languages; Russian-language playback is not guaranteed in every case. Further help: listening to a page in Safari. 4. Add a site icon For a quick way back, open the page you want and add its icon: Android / Chrome: menu (…) → Add to Home screen. iPhone / Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen. Windows / Edge: menu (…) → More tools → Apps → Install this site as an app. Confirm the addition or installation when prompted. Labels and menu locations may vary. An icon does not itself enable offline reading: download a book in advance and open it in a suitable reader.
